Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7597); Salathiel (i.e. Shealtiel), an Israelite:--Salathiel.
BiblicalUsage: Salathiel is an Israelite, the son of Jeconiah in the line of David. You find the name in Luke 3:27, "Which was of Joanna, which was of Rhesa…", and again in Matthew 1:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Salathiel is remembered because God keeps count of his own, name by name. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
